Both failures reproduce the reported symptom.

args.root_cause: In `calculate_tax`, the tax amount is quantized to cents with `rounding=ROUND_DOWN` (truncation) instead of half-up rounding. Any exact or fractional half-cent (or any fraction of a cent) is truncated, so e.g. $10.00 * 0.0725 = 0.7250 becomes 0.72 instead of 0.73. This makes CA tax (and therefore totals from `total_with_tax`) a cent low on boundary amounts. The test file already documents the intended behavior (round half up), so the fix is to use `ROUND_HALF_UP` in the quantize call in `library/tax.py`.

evidence.quote: # 10.00 * 7.25% = 0.7250 exactly -> rounds up to 0.73, not down to 0.72
